paragraphs.text: So that the gridiron or grate was half as high as the altar and stood within it.
paragraphs.label: a

paragraphs.text: R. Kimbi says that the women brought their looking glasses, which were of brass or fine metal, and offered them freely for the use of the tabernacle: which was a bright thing and of great majesty.
paragraphs.label: b

paragraphs.text: That the Levites might be in charge of it, and minister in the same, as did Eleazar and Ithamar, Nu 3:4.
paragraphs.label: c

paragraphs.text: Or, a graver, or carpenter, Ex 36:4.
paragraphs.label: d

paragraphs.text: Read the weight of a talent, Ex 25:39.
paragraphs.label: e
